notes: Actual checked-in integration harness, ten reviewed modules plus its real simulation/synthesis/formal/FPGA fixtures.
All source edits and generated starters stay in this temporary repository copy.
Harness explicitly substitutes a viewer executable and an intentional failing renderer for display/fallback assertions; HDL tool processes remain real.
Local pinned Verible is exposed for exhaustive lint. No portable-tools skip mode is used.

resolved_initial_failures.processing_array: Initial import failed before assertions because the example requires bitstring, bitarray, NumPy and Pillow. Unchanged example later completed RTL and gate simulation successfully with isolated verified matching-ABI Python dependencies. The existing example prints numerical outputs rather than asserting algorithm correctness.
resolved_initial_failures.PNG_validation: Initial suite Python lacked Pillow for the harness PNG oracle. Both actual synthesis PNG validation checks subsequently passed with isolated Pillow 11.3.0.

unresolved_failures: processor: vvp exits with SIGSEGV after the Cocotb assertion test and results XML report PASS; nonzero native result remains a failed workflow.
validation_dependency_scope: Downloaded, SHA-256/size verified and extracted only into /tmp, then loaded via explicit PYTHONPATH with the matching bundled CPython 3.11. System, managed suite and repository source packages unchanged.

sanitization.policy: User checkout, managed-suite and ephemeral project/dependency paths replaced by descriptive placeholders. Source/artifact/log hashes preserve the original bytes; sanitized log text has separate digests.
sanitization.ephemeral_logs: Commands include original log digests; temporary individual logs are not part of this repository snapshot. Selected diagnostic excerpts and processor case summaries are retained here.

historical_status: Superseded by hdl-representative-final-linux-x64.json. Initial failed status and unresolved-failure wording describe the historical run before the targeted runtime fix and explicit Python prerequisites.
